title: The Hedgehog

doing.t: is snuffling along with its nose to the ground
is rolled up into a tight, prickly ball
is scratching behind one ear with a back foot
is nosing at a windfall apple
is hibernating inside a bundle of dry leaves

close: Just the hedgehog, a nose and two black-bead eyes peeping out of the prickles.
Only the hedgehog, mid-trundle, with one front foot lifted.

roles.dark: for the nose, the eyes and the shadow under the belly
roles.light: for the cream tips of the spines

firstMark: Start with the nose: a small, polished point of {dark} at the end of the snout.
Start with the spines in short, fanned flicks of {main}, working back from the face.

title: The Dormouse

doing.t: is curled up fast asleep
is nibbling a hazelnut held in both paws
is climbing a honeysuckle stem
is snoozing inside a ball of dry grass

close: Just the dormouse, close enough to count whiskers.
Only the dormouse, curled into a ball, filling the page.

roles.dark: for the eye and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the pale belly and whiskers
roles.accent: for the pink nose and toes

firstMark: Start with the eye: one dot of {dark}, the size of a peppercorn.
Start with the curve of the back in a light pass of {main}.

title: The Wood Mouse

doing.t: is turning a sunflower seed round in its front paws
is standing on its back legs to sniff the air
is caught mid-leap with its long tail streaming out
is helping itself to a biscuit crumb
is carrying a rosehip off in its mouth

close: Just the wood mouse, with ears big enough to catch the light.
Only the mouse, sitting up, its long tail looped round its feet.

roles.dark: for the bulging black eyes
roles.light: for the white belly and feet
roles.accent: for the pink light glowing through the ears

firstMark: Start with the eye: a round, glossy blob of {dark}, bigger than you think.
Start with the ear, a light outline of {main} shaped like a scallop shell.

title: The Harvest Mouse
phrases: a nest woven from living grass

doing.t: is nibbling a single grain of wheat
is asleep with its tail wrapped over its nose
is sitting up on its haunches to look about
is clinging to a swaying stalk with its tail wound round it
is weaving a ball-shaped nest from shredded leaves

close: Just the harvest mouse, tail wound round a single stem.
Only the harvest mouse and the ear of wheat it is holding on to.

roles.dark: for the eye and the shadow under the chin
roles.light: for the white underside

firstMark: Start with the tail: one curling line of {main} wound round the stem.
Start with the eye, a single speck of {dark}, then the short snout just in front of it.

title: The Red Squirrel
phrases: pine cones stripped to the core

doing.t: is stripping a pine cone scale by scale
is sitting up with its tail arched over its back
is frozen mid-chew and staring straight back
is tucking a hazelnut away for later
is hanging head-down by its back feet

close: Just the squirrel and its great plume of a tail, nothing else.
Only the squirrel's face and those tufted ears, as big as the paper allows.

roles.dark: for the eye and the deepest parts of the tail
roles.light: for the cream chest
roles.accent: for the dark tips of the ear tufts

firstMark: Start with the ear tufts: two quick flicks of {main} pointing up and out.
Start with the eye, a dark almond of {dark} with a pinhead of paper left for the shine.

title: The Hare

doing.t: is sitting bolt upright with its ears turned to listen
is crouched low with its ears laid flat along its back
is pulling one long ear down to wash it
is loping away in no particular hurry
is standing up to box with a second hare

close: Just the hare, sitting up, ears tall enough to touch the top of the page.
Only the hare's head in profile, with that big amber eye.

roles.dark: for the black ear tips
roles.light: for the white chin and belly

firstMark: Start with the sooty ear tips in {dark}, then follow the ears down to the head.
Start with the pupil, a firm circle of {dark} set inside a wide amber eye.

title: The Wild Rabbit

doing.t: is washing its face with both front paws
is nibbling a dandelion leaf from the tip down
is lying flat with its back legs kicked out behind
is thumping a back foot in warning
is hopping off with its white tail bobbing

close: Just the rabbit in profile, from the twitching nose to the white scut.
Only the rabbit, seen from behind, ears up and tail showing.

roles.dark: for the eye and the shadow under the chin
roles.light: for the white tail and belly
roles.accent: for the rusty patch at the nape

firstMark: Start with the eye, a large round shape of {dark} set high on the side of the head.
Start with the ears in two long, light strokes of {main}.

title: The Fox Cub
phrases: a yip at the end of the lane

doing.t: is tugging at a lost glove
is sitting with its head cocked at a sound
is curled up nose to tail
is giving an enormous pink yawn
is pouncing on a dandelion clock
is wrestling a sibling in a tangle of legs

close: Just the cub, head on one side, ears far too big for it.
Only the fox cub's face, with its dark muzzle and white chin.

roles.dark: for the legs, the nose and the backs of the ears
roles.light: for the white chin and the tip of the tail

firstMark: Start with the nose: a small triangle of {dark} at the end of the muzzle.
Start with the ears, two tall triangles outlined lightly in {main}.

title: The Badger
phrases: a face striped like a humbug

doing.t: is having a long, thorough scratch
is trotting along with its striped nose low
is sitting back on its haunches and looking thoughtful
is hauling an armful of bracken backwards
is digging with its long front claws

close: Just the badger's face, a white stripe down the middle and dark eyes in the black.
Only the badger coming straight towards you, a wide grey body under that striped head.

roles.dark: for the black stripes and legs
roles.light: for the white stripes on the face
roles.accent: for the white tips of the ears

firstMark: Start with the two black face stripes in {dark}, leaving bare paper for the white between them.
Start with the body as one low wedge of {main}, heavy at the shoulders.

title: The Otter

doing.t: is juggling a small stone between its front paws
is rolling over and over for the fun of it
is shaking itself dry with drops flying
is galloping along in a rolling, humpbacked run
is sitting up with its whiskers dripping

close: Just the otter's head, sleek and wet, with its whiskers fanned out.
Only the otter, the whole length of it, from whiskered nose to thick, tapering tail.

roles.dark: for the nose and the deepest shadows
roles.light: for the shine where the fur is wet

firstMark: Start with the nose, a shape of {dark} like a flattened heart.
Start with the head as a smooth, flat oval in {main}, the ears barely showing.

title: The Stoat
phrases: a black tip to the tail

doing.t: is standing up on its back legs like a periscope
is pausing with one front foot raised
is asleep in a neat ginger knot
is twisting round to look back over its shoulder
is bounding along with its back arched

close: Just the stoat, standing up, with its cream bib and black-tipped tail.
Only the stoat's long body, curved like a letter S.

roles.dark: for the black tail tip and the eye
roles.light: for the cream bib and belly

firstMark: Start with the tail tip: a small, solid flame of {dark}.
Start with the line where ginger meets cream, a wavy edge of {main} along the side.

title: The Mole

doing.t: is pausing with its nose up and a puzzled air
is wiggling its long snout to sniff the air
is rowing itself along with its broad front paws
is surfacing nose first from a fresh molehill
is flinging soil out behind it

close: Just the mole, front on, with those two enormous pink hands.
Only the mole's head and paws, poking up out of the earth.

roles.dark: for the deepest shadow under the body
roles.light: for the sheen along the back
roles.accent: for the pink paws and snout

firstMark: Start with the body as one rounded bean shape in a light, even layer of {main}.
Start with the snout, a short pink cone, then the dark head behind it in {dark}.

title: The Pipistrelle Bat

doing.t: is stretching out one wing like a paper fan
is grooming its fur with quick, busy licks
is clinging on with its wings folded tight
is flitting about in jinking zigzags
is hanging upside down by its toes

close: Just the bat, wings spread wide, every finger bone showing through.
Only the pipistrelle, folded up and hanging, about the size of a walnut.

roles.dark: for the wings, the ears and the face
roles.light: for the paler fur underneath
roles.accent: for the reddish glow where light shines through the wing

firstMark: Start with the body: a furry oval of {main}, about the size of your thumbnail.
Start with the wing bones, four fine lines of {dark} fanning out from the wrist.

title: The Roe Deer Fawn
phrases: legs still too long for it

doing.t: is lying curled up with its chin pressed flat
is wobbling to its feet on long thin legs
is standing alert with its ears turned forward
is reaching up to taste a hazel leaf
is springing away with its pale rump flashing

close: Just the fawn, legs folded under, with every spot along its back.
Only the fawn's face: shiny black nose, big ears, bigger eyes.

roles.dark: for the nose and the huge eyes
roles.light: for the cream spots along the back
roles.accent: for the white patch on the chin

firstMark: Start with the eye: a wide, wet-looking oval of {dark}, set halfway down the long face.
Start with the spots: mark them lightly, then colour {main} round them so they stay bare paper.

title: The Red Deer Stag
phrases: a shaggy ruff at the throat
a roar that carries down the glen

doing.t: is standing side on with its head held high
is grazing with one ear turned back
is lying down to chew the cud
is bellowing with its head thrown back

close: Just the stag's head and antlers, right out to the edges of the paper.
Only the stag, far off, with plenty of empty space round it.

roles.dark: for the shaggy mane and the shadow under the belly
roles.light: for the pale rump patch

firstMark: Start with the antlers: two main beams in {dark}, then branch the points off them.
Start with the eye and the long line of the face below it in {dark}.

title: The Frog

doing.t: is sitting propped up on its front feet with its toes turned in
is mid-jump with its back legs at full stretch
is blinking at you with gold-ringed eyes
is peeping out with only its eyes and nose showing
is purring softly with its throat puffed out

close: Just the frog, facing you, two gold eyes and a wide, solemn mouth.
Only the frog's back foot, every long webbed toe, and nothing else.

roles.dark: for the blotches and the dark patch behind the eye
roles.light: for the shine on the wet back and the pale throat
roles.accent: for the gold in the eye

firstMark: Start with the dark mask behind the eye, a smudged teardrop of {dark}.
Start with the folded back leg, a long zigzag outlined lightly in {main}.

title: The Toad

doing.t: is plodding along one foot at a time
is sitting squat with its chin tucked low
is swallowing hard with its eyes squeezed shut
is heaving itself over a pebble with great determination
is wriggling backwards to bury itself

close: Just the toad, chin down and copper eyes up.
Only the toad, life size, every wart a small raised bump.

roles.dark: for the shadows between the warts
roles.light: for the buff throat and the shine on each bump

firstMark: Start with the eye: a ring of copper round a horizontal slot of {dark}.
Start with the warts on the back as small loose circles of {main}.

title: The Great Crested Newt
phrases: a belly of orange and ink
a crest like a ragged comb

doing.t: is creeping along on splayed toes
is resting with its chin on its front feet
is turning to show its orange underside
is half hidden with only its tail showing
is waving its tail to show off its crest

close: Just the newt, seen from below, with its orange belly and black spots.
Only the newt in profile, crest and all, from nose to tail tip.

roles.dark: for the black spots on the belly
roles.light: for the white speckles along the sides

firstMark: Start with the crest: a jagged line of {dark} running along the back.
Start with the body as one long, slim curve in {main}, the tail flattened like a blade.

title: The Slow Worm
phrases: a lizard that lost its legs

doing.t: is coiled up in a loose figure of eight
is lying quite motionless with its eyes half closed
is sliding along in slow, lazy curves
is tasting the air with a flick of its tongue

close: Just the slow worm, coiled in a loose spiral like a dropped necklace.
Only the slow worm's head: a calm eye and the faint smile of its mouth.

roles.dark: for the dark stripe down each side
roles.light: for the shine running along the back

firstMark: Start with the shine: draw a thin line along the back, keep it as bare paper and lay {main} on either side.
Start with the dark stripe along the flank in one unbroken line of {dark}.

title: The Water Vole
phrases: a blunt nose and buried ears

doing.t: is munching a grass stem like a stick of celery
is sitting hunched with its fur fluffed out
is combing its belly fur with both front paws
is sitting dripping wet with its fur in spikes

close: Just the water vole, sitting up to eat, a stem held to its mouth.
Only the vole's blunt face and bright bead of an eye, drawn large.

roles.dark: for the eye and the shadow under the chin
roles.light: for the paler fur on the belly

firstMark: Start with the eye, a glint of {dark} set close to the nose.
Start with the hunched back as one low hill of {main}.

title: The Shrew
phrases: a nose that never stops twitching

doing.t: is swivelling its long nose this way and that
is scurrying about at top speed
is sitting still for once
is flipping over a fallen leaf with its nose

close: Just the shrew, nose to tail, drawn the length of your thumb.
Only the shrew's face: that long nose and two pinprick eyes.

roles.dark: for the eyes and the shadow underneath
roles.light: for the pale belly
roles.accent: for the pink tip of the nose

firstMark: Start with the nose: one long, tapering stroke of {main} coming to a point.
Start with the eye, a speck of {dark} no bigger than a full stop.

title: The Grey Seal Pup

doing.t: is lying on its back with its flippers crossed
is scratching its chin with a front flipper
is heaving itself forward in clumsy lurches
is gazing up with its whiskers bristling

close: Just the seal pup, head on, all round face and dark eyes.
Only the pup, lying in a crescent, cream fur against bare paper.

roles.dark: for the eyes and the nose
roles.light: for the whitest fur along the top of the head

firstMark: Start with the eyes: two large circles of {dark}, set wide apart.
Start with the nose: a small Y of {dark} just below and between the eyes.
